name: Lian'ai Youxi Jinxingshi
source:
In parallel time and space, Tokyo, a megacity where the real estate foam has not burst, experiences life as a producer of GALGAME games.
The huge city of Tokyo, has brought many different possibilities for work and life.
Producers can walk on the streets of Shibuya at night, take the Yamaguchi line, visit Ueno Park after the rain, or the maid cafe in Akihabara electric street. Diet, consumption, work, dating, and even playing detective after game development to solve all kinds of strange stories.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/913170/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在平行时空中，房地产泡沫尚未破裂的超大都市东京，体验Galgame制作人的生活。
这座庞大的城市，为工作与生活提供了种种可能。
制作人们可以漫步夜晚的涩谷街头，乘坐山手线，游览雨后的上野公园，或流连于秋叶原电器街的女仆咖啡厅。吃饭、消费、工作、约会，甚至在开发游戏之余扮演侦探，解开各种奇闻怪谈。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/913170/]Steam[/url]]
